D1_numerical_monotonicity.pass: full-fit clipped slope b > 0; s_y > 0; all produced historical and grid multipliers finite and inside [0.97,1.03]

D2_loo_direction.zero_rule: If either side is exactly zero, agreement counts only when both are exactly zero.

D3_loo_rank.statistic: Spearman rho between the 11 LOO shadow multipliers and the 11 held-out y values

D4_single_class_mapping_stability.metric: maximum absolute multiplier difference between full-fit mapping and any single-class-deletion mapping over the frozen 5-point x grid

D5_historical_saturation.definition: full-fit historical multiplier exactly equals 0.97 or 1.03 after clipping

b21_acceptance_gates.joint_pass: D1 AND D2 AND D3 AND D4 AND D5

b21_execution_protocol.deletion_stability: delete each class, refit mapping on remaining 10, evaluate each deletion mapping on the same frozen full-sample stability grid
b21_execution_protocol.fixed_stability_grid: the full-sample sorted-x order statistics at 1st, 3rd, 6th, 9th, and 11th positions; no interpolation
b21_execution_protocol.full_fit: fit the frozen mapping on all 11 classes only after protocol/hash guards pass
b21_execution_protocol.loo_fit: for each held-out class, recompute a,b,x0,s_y using only the other 10 classes and score only the held-out x

downstream_boundary.b21_pass_authorizes: a separate preregistration for exact 2027 source identity/comparability and one research-only shadow score

historical_calibration_cohort.x: ln(projected fantasy-relevant Rich Hill top-60 capital)
historical_calibration_cohort.y: ln(actual fantasy-relevant Rich Hill top-60 capital)

layer_d_mapping.fit_model: OLS y=a+b*x with b=max(0, unconstrained OLS slope)
layer_d_mapping.interpretation: A bounded research index translating the validated capital-composition forecast into a conservative class-wide shadow signal; not an empirically proven causal FV elasticity.
layer_d_mapping.neutral_predicted_log_capital: yhat(x0)=a+b*x0 where x0 is training median x
layer_d_mapping.neutral_projected_reference: median x of the calibration training set
layer_d_mapping.outcome_scale: sample standard deviation of y in the calibration training set using denominator n-1
layer_d_mapping.scope: single class-level research shadow multiplier only
